# Operability Checklist: ISK-0008 — Local Developer Environment & Reproducible Compose

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the scripts, their exit codes and diagnostics, start-up, smoke, reset, recovery, and documentation are complete, clear, and measurable
**Created**: 2026-11-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Scripts

- [x] CHK001 - Is each script's name, options, and effect specified, with what it keeps and what it removes? [Completeness, Spec §TR-11, Contract §Scripts]
- [x] CHK002 - Is start's success condition defined exactly, including that it does not wait for readiness? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Clarifications (clarify), Research R4]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the prerequisites and their minimum versions listed, with how a version is compared? [Measurability, Spec §AV-2, Contract §Scripts, Research R12]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the `bash` 3.2 constraint stated as a list of excluded constructs and permitted tools, so it can be reviewed? [Clarity, Spec §AV-3, Research R12, Tasks §Notes for every task]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the behavior from a subdirectory, outside a checkout, and with CRLF settings defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-024, Contract §Layout 4, §Scripts]

## Exit Codes and Diagnostics

- [x] CHK006 - Does each exit code have one class, and does each failure name its check, service, or variable without a value? [Clarity, Spec §TR-12, Contract §Exit codes]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the difference between a port found in use before start (2) and a bind that fails during start (1) defined, with what each names? [Clarity, Contract §Ports 3, Research R10]
- [x] CHK008 - Is a start against an already-running topology defined, so its own published port does not count as in use? [Edge Case, Contract §Ports 3, Tasks T022, T037]
- [x] CHK009 - Does the documentation requirement give, for each exit code, the action that resolves it, as TR-12's rationale promises? [Gap, Spec §TR-12, §FR-023, Tasks T040]
  - Settled in `checklist`: TR-12 says one code per class tells a developer which runbook entry to read, but T040 listed the exit codes with no action. T040 now gives each exit code with the action that resolves it.

## Start-up and Seed-free State

- [x] CHK010 - Are first start and later start distinguished by observable state: the password file, provisioning, and what is generated? [Completeness, Spec §US1.5, §US1.6, Data model §Lifecycle]
- [x] CHK011 - Is "seed-free" defined measurably, as no schema outside the system ones and no relation in `public`? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Smoke assertions 5]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the health check for `postgres` specified so that it cannot pass before provisioning finishes? [Edge Case, Contract §PostgreSQL 3, Research R7]
- [x] CHK013 - Are mode switches defined in both directions, with the volumes reused and the dependency ports removed in the default mode? [Coverage, Contract §Modes, Research R2]

## Smoke

- [x] CHK014 - Is the smoke failure behavior defined: every check runs, each failure is named, and checks that need a stopped service are skipped? [Clarity, Contract §Smoke assertions, Research R13]
- [x] CHK015 - Are the failure cases of US2 (Valkey stopped, PostgreSQL stopped, persistence `ok`, no topology) each mapped to a test? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003, Tasks T032, T034]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the wait for `lifecycle` to leave `starting` bounded, and is the outcome when the bound passes defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Smoke assertions 3]

## Reset and Recovery

- [x] CHK017 - Is the recovery path from each invalid local state named: a volume without its password file, an unusable password file, and a service that will not start? [Coverage, Contract §Passwords 2, §Exit codes]
- [x] CHK018 - Is "a clean reset" defined measurably, with a control project's resources shown to remain? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Tasks T035]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the next start after a reset defined as a fresh first start, with new passwords? [Completeness, Spec §US4.3, Data model §Lifecycle]

## Acceptance and Documentation

- [x] CHK020 - Is the acceptance evidence, "a fresh clone starts with no external credentials", tied to a measurable outcome run in CI? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §FR-022, Tasks T038]
- [x] CHK021 - Are slow CI runs addressed without lowering the cycle count or asserting a time? [Non-Functional, Plan §Risks, Tasks T038]
- [x] CHK022 - Are the documentation's contents listed, and are they in the docs gate so later changes stay in step? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, Research R1, R18]
- [x] CHK023 - Are the quickstart scenarios required to be run once and their results recorded, with a mismatch treated as a defect? [Measurability, Tasks T042]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
